Important: A monitoring gap means that data was not collected during that period. The monitor cannot determine from the CSV alone whether the Mac was shut down, asleep, disconnected, or the monitoring service was stopped.

Interpretation

Expected broadband plan: 100 Mbps download / 100 Mbps upload.

Speed below 50 Mbps is flagged as degraded for monitoring purposes.

BEYOND_ROUTER indicates that the router-side measurements looked healthier than one or more Internet-side measurements during that sample. It is evidence of degradation beyond the local router path, but does not by itself prove an ISP fault.
